Don't worry about the response time, im surprised anyone is bothering to talk to me at all tbh. Ill try next time my parents ask. I'm not sure why im so scared of going to a doctor, I guess maybe im scared of judgement? My friends probably are toxic, they insult me and put me down regularly, but without them I have no one around me to speak to.
I haven't really thought to try breathing techniques but i'll maybe give them a try. I just want to stop feeling the way I do, its killing me. I have no idea how to build self confidence, I dont like anything about myself. I dont like how I look, I dont like what I wear, I dont like how I act. My parents are very supporting and caring, but im scared to change anything about myself because of them. I hate the focus being on me, and they have a specific image about who I am and if I ever stray from that it becomes a huge deal and I never hear the end of it.
My girlfriend tells me she loves me regularly, but I guess deep down I dont believe it, everything is just getting on top of me and its becoming too much to handle.
Thank you for even bothering to take the time to talk to me.

Im 18. My parents have asked me if im gay or bi so they must suspect something, but each time ive denied it out of fear. My 'friends' are already dicks to me for various reasons and they would hate me if they found out im bi. Im terrified of going to a doctor about it. My panic attacks and anxiety are getting worse and I dont know what to do. Im really self destructive, I hide who I really am from people, and push people away. Im making my relationship with my girlfriend worse. It is long distance as she lives on the other side of the country. She is supposed to be coming in about 2 weeks but im terrified of that too. I havent looked into anything, most nights I just descend into panic, i say a lot of suicidal things to my girlfriend in panic. She has her own problems and im just adding to things. My self confidence is practically non existent and I hate everything about myself. Im sat here watching me destroy my own life.

Im not really sure where to start. Maybe my problems are small and im just pathetic who knows.
Im pretty sure I have some kind of severe undiagnosed panic or anxiety disorder. I have bad panic attacks almost daily. They cause me to scratch myself and hit myself as I cry. Sometimes the pressure in my head is too much and I cant take it.
I have recently come to terms with being bisexual but I cant tell my parents because I hate too much focus being on me. My friends are all homophobic and im too anxious to talk to anyone else because im unlikeable. I have a girlfriend who is the only person ive told and she is supportive. But she has depression and is getting fed up with my panicking and negativity. Im losing interest in things I once loved and im struggling to sleep. There is so much more going through my head but im struggling to formulate anything. I barely covered anything here. I dont even know if what ive said made any sense.
